title: Output Flipping Preserves Halting
statement: Let $N$ be a finite-state nondeterministic Turing machine over the binary alphabet, and let $x$ be a binary input and $t\in\mathbb{N}$. The machine obtained from $N$ by complementing each bit it emits halts on $x$ within $t$ steps along every branch if and only if $N$ does.
hypotheses_covered: N is a finite-state nondeterministic machine over Bool
